_comment: Fragment 100 — B-061/D-162: eight Lane B-facing inputs still described pre-S1 state after S1 completed, corrected in one pass; the next code unit stays undefined pending Q12/Q1. Left absent from the graph by the same G109-class extraction gap. Merged 2026-08-30.

nodes.label: Eight Lane B-Facing Inputs Described Pre-S1 State After S1 Completed
nodes.description: Lane B reviewed whether the documents and dependencies a future Lane B code-creation run would read were current, after D-161 confirmed no execution run was ready. They were not: the shared core, AGENTS.md's own S0 kickoff section, V1-BUILD-SPEC.md, V1-ARTIFACT-INVENTORY.md, Modular_PRD.md's status tables, FN-GATES-01-05.md, CONFIG_LOG.md, and DECISION_LOG.md all still described Q11 as open, 0002 as blocked or unwritten, or artifacts as absent that had existed since S0/S1 completed. A green consistency suite proved the documents were connected, not that their sentences were true. D-162 fact-checked and corrected all eight against the filesystem and register.
nodes.rationale: Mechanical consistency checks (tier-sweep, decision-status) verify that a decision arrived in a tier, not that the tier's sentences are still true afterward — a gap this corpus has named before (G65) but not this widely at once. The parent gap (no next Lane B code unit defined, blocked on Q12/Q1) and the S2 UX-spec question were deliberately left open rather than resolved, since both are genuine Chief Editor decisions no documentation correction can substitute for.
